subject: CL-2: Integrate Zonoid as the memory backend in the SWE-Bench-CL harness
description: Per the CL-1 integration plan (bench/swe-bench-cl/INTEGRATION-PLAN.md). Implement a Zonoid memory adapter that plugs into the agents-never-forget LangGraph harness at the FAISS memory seam: retrieval → Zonoid search_knowledge / daemon /search against a per-sequence workspace; write-after-task → record/inject so KB compounds across the chronological sequence. Wire the 3-arm toggle (OFF=no memory, FAISS=native, Zonoid=adapter) as a config switch. Commit the adapter + any harness patches under bench/swe-bench-cl/. Do NOT run the Docker eval here (that is CL-3 on the Windows box) — this is the integration + a dry/smoke check that the memory backend toggles and the adapter's read/write path works against the daemon. Depends on CL-1.

summary: CL-2 done. Delivered drop-in Zonoid memory adapter under bench/swe-bench-cl/ (commit 64d2faf): zonoid_memory.py (ZonoidMemorySystem, duck-typed to FAISS's 3-method seam) + APPLY.md (Windows wiring, dep pins, smoke capture). ROUND-TRIP + WORKSPACE ISOLATION VERIFIED YES via the adapter's own Python self-test against the live daemon (write WS-A -> retrieve from A hit, from B empty). GATING UNKNOWN RESOLVED: daemon /search + /overlay/note DO accept a workspace param, BUT it MUST be an ABSOLUTE FILESYSTEM PATH (daemon does path.join(ws,'.graph')) -- a relative namespace string silently fails to persist (write ok:true but /search empty). Other findings: write route is POST /overlay/note (NOT /record_decision, that's MCP-only); must pass force:true to bypass the 0.70 dup guard (else note is retrieval-invisible pending judge); /search is GET query-string (POST ignores query); score higher=better (don't sort asc); first /search lazy-loads embedder ~10-90s (warm_up() provided). Toggle wiring point: MEMORY_BACKEND branch at eval_v1/eval_procedure.py ~L1105 (constructor) + import + ~L157 config knob; OFF arm needs zero work. Did NOT run Docker eval (CL-3, Windows).
